scope: Asset-only factual reference research for central Ștefan cel Mare corridor, within Sfatul Țării–Ismail; two requested anchors plus six building/frontage samples. No Site code changed.

method.levels: Storeys below refer to total visible above-ground levels, including the ground floor, unless explicitly qualified. Counts are facade observations, not a cadastral survey. Two-level halls, raised basements, roofs, towers, and tall civic floors must not be flattened into identical residential floors.
method.height_measurements: No surveyed/elevation-drawing metre heights were located in this bounded search. All actual_height_m values are null. Optional modelling ranges are rough proxies, not factual measured heights.
method.licensing: Downloaded photos are inspection references. A source URL or public availability does not automatically grant reuse as a shipped game texture. Commons license details are given where verified.
method.coverage_limit: Samples cover different building types within the corridor; they are not a building-by-building inventory or statistically representative sample of every block.

pman_overhead.name: PMAN / Triumphal Arch / Government House aerial overview
pman_overhead.author: Pelin Oleg
pman_overhead.view: Elevated oblique aerial looking from Cathedral Park across arch to Government House; not an orthophoto.
observations: Triumphal Arch stands at the south edge of Cathedral Park, immediately adjacent to a paved sidewalk/apron and the boulevard.
Across the boulevard toward Government House is a very broad asphalt roadway/PMAN hardscape; do not fill this zone with park lawn.
Government side has a narrow formal lawn/landscape strip and front walk, interrupted by the central paved entrance steps/apron.
Behind the arch toward the cathedral, the park begins with semi-circular/radial paved paths around distinct lawn sectors, with dense trees further to both sides.
Keep boulevard pavement and pedestrian paths visually distinct, while both remain hardscape.

secondary_top_down_reference.author: Pelin Oleg
secondary_top_down_reference.use: True overhead of cathedral/park paths only; frame omits arch-government crossing. Use overview for PMAN boundary.

modelling_takeaway: Do not assign every boulevard building four floors. Verified/observed anchors include City Hall 2 tall levels, Hasdeu 3, Post Office 4 visible levels, 132 corner 5 visible levels, and Government 6.
Model the shop base, upper floors, cornice and roof separately; narrow horizontal bands are not automatically independent storeys.
Treat halls, theatres, domes and towers as building-specific volumes.
Use metre estimates only as explicitly approximate starting points; no actual measured heights were found.
